Name: Machir, Son of Ammiel
Summary: Machir, son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, had sheltered Mephibosheth, Jonathan's lame son, in his house. He later brought provisions to David at Mahanaim during Absalom's revolt.
KeyStory: Machir sheltered Jonathan's son in Lo-debar, then fed David at Mahanaim.
RelatedPeople: Mephibosheth, Son of Jonathan; King David; Ammiel, Father of Machir
LifeLesson: The man who shelters the forgotten is ready to feed the king.
